sources.title: WINNER II Channel Model for Communications Toolbox
sources.snippet: Using WINNER II channel models, you can model and simulate spatially-defined channels for multi-user MIMO wireless systems. You can specify an arbitrary number of base stations (BS) and mobile stations (MS) together with their geometry and location information.
